sentenceSets.sentence: The wistful tone of the retrospective suggested that those who had been present still believed the outcome should have been different.

answerChoices.reasoning: Nostalgic means sentimental about the past, but wistful adds the element of yearning and melancholy—not just sentimental recall but unfulfilled longing.
Longing means desiring something absent, but wistful adds the melancholy tinge—yearning tinged with sadness, not just desire.
Reflective means thoughtful and contemplative, but wistful adds the elements of yearning and melancholy to the reflection.
Regretful means feeling sorrow for past actions, but wistful specifically adds the yearning quality—not just regret but unfulfilled longing.
Melancholy means sad and pensive, but wistful specifically emphasizes yearning and longing tinged with melancholy.
Yearning means intense longing, but wistful adds the melancholy tinge—longing that is sadly unfulfilled.
Pensive means deeply thoughtful, but wistful adds the elements of yearning and sadness to the pensiveness.
Bittersweet means mixing pleasure with sadness, but wistful emphasizes yearning and melancholy rather than mixed emotions.
Cheerful means happy and light, opposite to wistful which expresses yearning and melancholy.
Satisfied means content and fulfilled, opposite to wistful which expresses unfulfilled yearning and regret.
Indifferent means unconcerned or unmoved, opposite to wistful which expresses deep yearning and melancholy.
